about: The 10 February 2026 assessment records subclinical hypothyroidism as the reason for treatment, with TSH 6.8 mU/L and free T4 15 pmol/L before Eltroxin starts on 17 February.
Possible finding: the record shows Eutroxsig supplies but gives no original indication, pretreatment TSH or pretreatment free T4.
At the pre-treatment assessment for subclinical hypothyroidism, free T4 was in range and TSH was exactly 10.0 mU/L, the sole reason this Oroxine supply falls outside the criterion.
